/understand-myself.title: Understand myself
/understand-myself.lead: Read, listen, or explore a questionnaire.

sections.title: What you can explore
sections.text: EmTalk brings together nine articles about sleep and burnout, each with an audio version, and five questionnaire pages.

sections.title: Why start here?
sections.text: Start with a topic you want to understand. Reading and listening offer context; questionnaires give you a set of questions to reflect on.

sections.title: How to begin
sections.text: Choose Read articles to browse the articles and listen on their pages. Choose Explore tests to see the available questionnaires. You can return here and choose a different resource at any time.

/tapl.title: TAPL
/tapl.lead: TAPL is in development and is not available to try yet. This page marks its place in EmTalk while development continues. You can explore EmTalk's articles and tests now.

/dm/workspace.title: Decision Matrix guest workspace
/dm/workspace.lead: Compare options and weigh pros and cons locally, without an account.

/dm.title: Try Decision Matrix in your browser
/dm.lead: Compare your options and weigh pros and cons. The guest workspace runs locally and needs no account. AI assistance is available in the DM app; web support is coming later.

/bret.title: Try BRET in your browser
/bret.lead: Breathe with one of five rhythms, create your own, or try progressive muscle relaxation. Free to use, without an account.

/bret/practice.title: Make a little room to breathe.
/bret/practice.lead: Choose a breathing rhythm or relax one muscle group at a time. No account needed.
